name: 25309-streamdetok-kimilinear48b-tp8
model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, ungated, PINNED. ~49.1B parameters (~98 GB of weights, ~12.3 GB per card at TP8), ~3B active per token. Its tokenizer ships as remote code, so the server must run with trust-remote-code enabled.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, one whole a3 node. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, no speculative decoding.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2048 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, STREAMING. Prompts 512 tokens (stdev 128, clamped 256-1024) against 1024 output tokens (stdev 128, clamped 768-1280), `temperature: 0.0`, `ignore_eos: true` so the running batch does not decay, seed 42.
purpose: A streaming long-form writing assistant on a 48-billion-parameter model, serving 512 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form: one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED silently, and the
# engine then starts without something this file claims to declare.
# Everything not named here is left at its release default.
model-path: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 8
trust-remote-code: true
